panels.description: This charts how long each completed backup run took, from its recorded run. A steady duration is normal; a sharp increase can mean the nightly backup is slowing. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'duration_s')::double precision AS duration_s FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_run' AND detail->>'phase' = 'applied' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Backup run duration

panels.description: This charts the size of files in each completed backup set, excluding the database backup repository, from the set inventory. A stable size is expected; sudden growth can consume the space kept for backups. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'set_bytes')::double precision AS set_bytes FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_run' AND detail->>'phase' = 'applied' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Backup set bytes

panels.description: This shows the share of sampled files reused from the previous local backup set rather than copied again, from the backup's link check. Some reuse is expected after the first set; zero reused files with a previous sample makes the run fail. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(detail->'hard_links') = 'object' THEN (detail->'hard_links'->>'linked')::double precision / NULLIF((detail->'hard_links'->>'sampled')::double precision, 0) ELSE (detail->>'hard_links')::double precision END AS hard_link_ratio FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_run' AND detail->>'phase' = 'applied' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Hard-link ratio

panels.description: This compares bytes sent off the box with the total snapshot size for each recorded push. A first push may send everything; later pushes should send under 90 percent, or the push fails. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'transferred_bytes')::double precision AS transferred_bytes, (detail->>'total_bytes')::double precision AS total_bytes FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_push' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Push transferred versus total bytes

panels.description: This charts paths checked on the backup target and old target snapshots removed during each recorded push. Checked paths show the copy was verified, while zero removed snapshots is normal when none has expired; a failed check prevents a successful push row. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'verified')::double precision AS verified, (detail->>'pruned')::double precision AS pruned FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_push' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Verified and pruned counts

panels.description: This charts how long each backup restore drill took, from its recorded run. A steady duration is expected; a sharp increase can make the next scheduled drill harder to finish. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, (detail->>'duration_s')::double precision AS duration_s FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_drill' ORDER BY at

panels.title: Restore drill duration

panels.description: This table lists recorded backup drill results, newest first. Pass means the restore checks succeeded; failed means they did not and causes a page. Follow docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, detail->>'result' AS result FROM audit_log WHERE kind = 'backup_drill' ORDER BY at DESC

panels.title: Restore drill result

panels.description: This table lists the ten newest recorded backup runs, pushes, drills, and restores with their results and sizes. Completed runs and passing drills are healthy; failures or missing expected runs need investigation. Read docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at, kind, detail->>'duration_s' AS duration_s, detail->>'result' AS result, detail->>'set_bytes' AS set_bytes, detail->'hard_links' AS hard_links, detail->>'transferred_bytes' AS transferred_bytes, detail->>'total_bytes' AS total_bytes, detail->>'verified' AS verified, detail->>'pruned' AS pruned FROM audit_log WHERE kind IN ('backup_run', 'backup_push', 'backup_drill', 'restore') AND (kind <> 'backup_run' OR detail->>'phase' = 'applied') ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Last ten backup and restore runs
